/* Generator fixture'u zapisu bazy z WYDANEGO builda 1.0 (schemat 19; uruchamiany w kopii tagu, np. `git archive v1.0.0-b1032`; wynik do
 * tests/fixtures/released/ głównego repo). Dane syntetyczne. Jak gen-fixture.ts.txt, plus pola dodane w 0.20–1.0 bez podbicia schematu
 * (M1-audytor-generalny-014, DEC-03 b, 27.10.2026): treningi na żywo i State.liveDays, pauzy, strefa startu, własne ćwiczenie, ćwiczenie
 * z biblioteki zmienione przez użytkownika (catalogRev 'user'), ustawienia voice / haptics, tydzień deload, zmiana dnia planu, okno „Uczciwe zasady”. */
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as store from '@/lib/store';
import { fresh, ex, withDemoTemplates, addWorkout } from './helpers';

jest.setTimeout(60000);
const OUT = process.env.FIXTURE_OUT!;
const TAG = process.env.FIXTURE_TAG!;
test('generuje fixture', async () => {
  jest.useFakeTimers({ now: new Date(2026, 9, 26, 18, 30).getTime(), doNotFake: ['nextTick', 'setImmediate', 'queueMicrotask'] });
  await fresh(); const st = () => store.getState(); const used: string[] = [];
  const tpls = withDemoTemplates(); used.push('templates');
  const L = require('@/lib/locations');
  try { const home = L.addLocation('home', 'Dom'); const gym = L.addLocation('gym', 'Siłownia'); L.setMainLocation(gym.id); used.push('locations'); void home; } catch (e) { used.push('NO-locations'); }
  const DAY = 86400e3; const now = Date.now();
  addWorkout(now - 9 * DAY, [['Back Squat', [{ weight: 60, reps: 8, kind: 'warmup', warmup: true }, { weight: 100, reps: 5, rpe: 8 }, { weight: 100, reps: 5 }]], ['Bench Press (sztanga)', [{ weight: 80, reps: 8 }, { weight: 80, reps: 7, note: 'ciężko' }]]], 'Dół A');
  addWorkout(now - 6 * DAY, [['Pull Up', [{ weight: '', reps: 6 }, { weight: '', reps: 5 }]], ['Bench Press (sztanga)', [{ weight: 82.5, reps: 6 }, { weight: 70, reps: 10, kind: 'drop' }]]], 'Góra A');
  addWorkout(now - 3 * DAY, [['Back Squat', [{ weight: 102.5, reps: 5 }, { weight: 102.5, reps: 5 }, { weight: 102.5, reps: 4 }]]], 'Dół B'); used.push('workouts');
  try { st().bodyMassLog = [{ date: '2026-10-01', kg: 82.4 }, { date: '2026-10-08', kg: 82.1 }]; used.push('bodyMassLog'); } catch {}
  try { st().mornings.push({ id: 'm1', ownerId: 'local', createdAt: now - DAY, updatedAt: now - DAY, date: '2026-10-25', bb: 70, sleepScore: 80, sleepH: 7.5, weight: 82.1 } as never); used.push('mornings'); } catch {}
  st().weekPlan = { days: [tpls[0].id, null, tpls[1].id, null, tpls[0].id, null, null], name: 'Plan A' }; used.push('weekPlan');
  const W = store as any;
  if (W.appendPlanSegment) { try { st().planHistory = W.appendPlanSegment(st().planHistory ?? [], '2026-10-05', st().weekPlan!.days); used.push('planHistory'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-planHistory'); } }
  try { (st() as any).savedPlans = [{ id: 'sp1', name: 'Plan B', days: [tpls[1].id, null, null, tpls[0].id, null, tpls[1].id, null] }]; used.push('savedPlans'); } catch {}
  if (L.addOneOffLocation) { try { const o = L.addOneOffLocation('Hotel', [], false, 'Tylko dziś'); (st() as any).planPlaces = { '2026-10-28': o.id }; (st().savedPlans![0] as any).places = { '2026-11-03': o.id }; used.push('oneOff', 'planPlaces'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-oneOff:' + String(e)); } }
  try { st().planOverrides = { '2026-10-29': null }; used.push('planOverrides'); } catch {}
  try { W.toggleDeloadWeek(new Date(2026, 9, 19, 12).getTime()); used.push('deloadWeeks'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-deloadWeeks'); }
  try { const own = W.newExercise('Wiosłowanie na TRX'); own.notes = 'pasy na 3. dziurce'; own.restSec = 75; used.push('ownExercise'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-ownExercise'); }
  try { W.setEquipment(ex('Bench Press (sztanga)'), 'hantle'); used.push('libEditedByUser'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-libEditedByUser'); }
  st().settings.defaultRest = 105; st().settings.autoBackup = true; (st().settings as any).voice = 'speaker'; (st().settings as any).haptics = false; used.push('voice', 'haptics');
  (st() as any).seenFairRulesManifest = true; used.push('seenFairRulesManifest');
  await store.flush();
  /* trening NA ŻYWO zakończony (live: true → State.liveDays), z pauzą */
  jest.setSystemTime(now - 2 * DAY);
  store.startFromTemplate(tpls[1]); let a = st().active!; a.exercises[0].sets[0].weight = 40; a.exercises[0].sets[0].reps = 10; store.toggleDone(0, 0);
  try { jest.setSystemTime(now - 2 * DAY + 5 * 60e3); W.pauseWorkout(); jest.setSystemTime(now - 2 * DAY + 8 * 60e3); W.resumeWorkout(); used.push(st().active!.pauses?.length ? 'pauses' : 'NO-pauses'); } catch (e) { used.push('NO-pauses'); }
  jest.setSystemTime(now - 2 * DAY + 40 * 60e3); a = st().active!; a.exercises[0].sets[1].weight = 40; a.exercises[0].sets[1].reps = 9; store.toggleDone(0, 1);
  store.finishWorkout(Date.now()); used.push('liveWorkout');
  if ((st() as any).liveDays?.length) used.push('liveDays'); else used.push('NO-liveDays');
  await store.flush();
  jest.setSystemTime(now);
  store.startFromTemplate(tpls[0]); a = st().active!; a.exercises[0].sets[0].weight = 100; a.exercises[0].sets[0].reps = 5; store.toggleDone(0, 0); used.push('active');
  store.save(a); await store.flush();
  if ((store as any).saveCfg) { st().settings.defaultRest = 110; (store as any).saveCfg(); await jest.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(500); used.push('cfg-key'); } /* sama zmiana konfiguracji -> mały klucz „cfg” */
  const g = (k: string) => (global.__kv.has(k) ? JSON.parse(global.__kv.get(k)!) : null);
  const out = { _comment: `Zapis bazy (klucze state, live, cfg) z wydanego builda ${TAG}; dane syntetyczne, wygenerowane z kodu tego tagu (M1-audytor-generalny-014, generator gen-fixture-1.0.ts.txt)`, tag: TAG, schemaVersion: g('state').schemaVersion, features: used, state: g('state'), live: g('live'), cfg: g('cfg') };
  fs.mkdirSync(require('path').dirname(OUT), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(OUT, JSON.stringify(out, null, 1) + '\n');
});
